verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent data controls. Users can review and edit what memory has saved and turn memory and chat search on or off. Incognito chats and a Model Improvement privacy setting control whether chats are used for training. Settings > Privacy offers data export. None of this documents deleting conversations or setting retention periods, so the core story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: documented chat/account deletion, configurable retention windows, deletion timelines after removal, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
